failureAnalysis.scope: Primary causes from visual inspection of the 17 existing-development misses. Labels unchanged; not used as new training images.

secondaryNotes.162: Several digit/field omissions, not a safe sign-only repair.
secondaryNotes.1072: Coordinate delimiter and signs missing together; no base XY to repair.
secondaryNotes.1071: Original raw model omits X minus. Old model contrast probe does not confidently identify a minus either; do not force repair.

failureAnalysis.trainingResponse: Add 24 other train-only unique XYZ: eight grass, eight rock, eight snow. Train both actual native raw and contrast variants for all training sources.

fixedTrial.acceptanceRule: Prefer more development XY correct only among zero known XY error and zero absent FP candidates; otherwise retain prior153/0/17. Development selection is not independent acceptance.

failureAnalysis.independentAcceptance: Freeze final weights/code/calibration before looking at new session. New truth cannot come from the OCR under test. Sign coverage recorded as observed; unavailable positive X remains unverified.

trainingRun.scope: Fixed100 final epoch, fit-only framework val; expanded sources and input variants, not a one-factor or compute-matched trial.

report.scope: Fixed same-session development selection is NOT independent acceptance. Fit91 separate. No old truth changed.
report.selectionRule: Max correct among>=153 correct,0 known XY wrong,0 absentFP; ties prefer earlier fixed simple pipeline order.

onnxCheck.scope: Actual CPU ONNX two-route inference + final sign repair vs PyTorch, not accuracy.

independentCandidateLock.scope: Independent future capture only. Models and thresholds frozen before capture. No training or calibration on acceptance data.
independentCandidateLock.baselinePipeline: prior-raw-layout; baseline raw detections + frozen decode + frozen layout audit

acceptance.labelPolicy: Direct clear coordinate transcription, with same-frame minimap/SURF support and stationary-group evidence; unresolved frames remain unknown. OCR predictions are never ground truth.
acceptance.primary: Exact XY on confirmed present; wrong XY, abstentions, absent false positives separately. Z optional.
acceptance.gate: No known wrong XY or absent false positive; compare paired coverage against frozen baseline. Inspect and report regressions. Missing positive-X or sign quadrants remain unverified.
acceptance.capturePlan: Familiar route; stationary camera turns in grass and snow. No requirement to hunt signs. Record actual sign coverage afterwards.
